title: Media and Collaboration Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Funny how money and war travel so well together.
Quick enough to avoid jhovalls when alone and fierce enough to attack them in packs, the hounds were as at home in the mountains as the Mercadians were atop theirs.
It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

"As it moved, the wurm's spines gathered up bits of flowstone, which took the shapes of dead villagers' heads. Each head spoke a single sound, but if taken together, they said, 'Alas for the living.'" —Dal myth of the wurm
An inferno is just a gesture away.
Grant limitless flight through the clouds, into battle, and across hardwood floors.
The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.
Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."
Lightning tethers souls to the world. —Kor saying
"Ultimecia is a fearful sorceress. Her heart is filled with anger and hate." —Edea Kramer
"It's not over yet... this isn't the end!"
"This is the end... for all of you."
The swarm seemed unmoved by the artificial slivers' destruction. "They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed. "I guess we'll have to do this the hard way."
In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.
"I heard you were making my favorite, Aunt May . . ."
". . . and I couldn't wait to swing by."
Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.
"From void evolved Phyrexia. Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection. Thus the Grand Evolution began." —Phyrexian Scriptures
"Hmm... maybe lotuses this year."
"We hope you'll thrive here, and by thriving, prove Strixhaven is the best magical university in existence, capable of meeting the needs of students from across the Planes." —Kasmina
The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.
Home is where your pizza delivers.
"On today's tour, you will be allowed into my most secured inner sanctum to see, in the flesh, my newest acquisitions: The Guardians of the Galaxy." —The Collector
"Am I the only one around here having any fun?"
Shuri enjoys rhythms as complex as her algorithms.
By dawn's early light, through the perilous fight, Steve Rogers was still there.
The chick has no name, as voicing the true identity of the animal might trigger ripples of destiny across Cocoon and cause a hurricane in Eden. Either that, or Sazh just hasn't thought of one yet.
Motivation was high in the academy once students realized flunking their exams could kill them.
Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.
"That is what it is to be human: to make yourself more than you are."
"In critical moments, men sometimes see exactly what they wish to see."
"If we're going to lose, then we're going to go down fighting, so that when our descendants someday rise up against the Dominion, they'll know what they're made of!"
"Power. Such an ephemeral commodity—hard to gain, easy to lose. And I once thought I understood it. What vanity."
"I watched him rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half once. A few vampires will barely slow him down." —Huatli
A sky bison is a companion for life.
"Heroes save people. It's what we do."
